rationale: Release candidate gates are frozen prior to soak execution. Thresholds cannot be relaxed post-test without formal exception documentation.
rules: Thresholds are immutable during soak execution.
Unmeasured metrics must strictly remain null/None and never be asserted as product claims.
Any modification of gates requires architectural sign-off and documented justification.

crash_free_sessions_pct.description: Percentage of user sessions completing without unhandled crash, kernel panic, or abnormal exit.

crash_free_runtime_hours.description: Continuous background runtime without process termination or crash.

task_completion_rate.description: Proportion of valid, non-negated user requests that successfully execute and verify.

false_action_rate.description: Rate of unintended, negated, or misrouted tool actions executed.

cancel_latency_p95_ms.description: 95th percentile latency from cancel signal emission to full execution interruption.

startup_readiness_p95_ms.description: 95th percentile time from cold process start to fully ready STT and listening pipeline.

max_memory_growth_mb_per_24h.description: Maximum allowable steady-state resident memory growth per 24 hours of background operation (leak prevention).

orphan_process_count.description: Number of orphaned child, grandchild, STT, or harness processes remaining after quit or crash (strict 0 tolerated).

update_success_rate.description: Proportion of updater transaction applications that successfully verify and complete.

update_rollback_rate.description: Acceptable rate of bricked installations; failed updates must cleanly roll back with 0 state corruption.
